themes.summary: Many buyers say the banner is simple to set up, customizable, and works reliably for announcements and promotions.

I connected the banner to my website without any issues.

It's really easy to make banners.
Extraordinary option to generate leads, highly recommended.
Very useful for a SAAS business to make sure users are aware of new functionality.
It is working great and the config options cover my basic use case scenario.
It was a breeze to set up, and I love how customizable it is
Setup - could not be easier
The banners are sleek and auto adjust sizing to fit desktop and mobile.
Answerly Banner will display a modern a slick Black Friday banner on my site
